---
title: Camera View
---

Display a device-camera feed in a spatial card. Use **Previous** and **Next**
to cycle through the available inputs, then move or resize the card.

The simulator normally supplies its virtual environment feed. Connected webcams
and headset camera inputs depend on runtime support and permission; do not
assume a particular physical camera will appear in the list.

[Cameras, video, and snapshots](/sdk/camera) · [Simulator controls](/sdk/simulator) · [Example catalog](/examples)
